page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m2.2xlarge is an entry-tier virtual server within the shared ecs.s6 family, hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon Platinum 8269CY processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance delivers 8 virtual CPUs paired with 16.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 compute-oriented ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Storage and networking resources rely entirely on external services. The instance features no bundled local disk storage, necessitating remote block storage attachments for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is rated at a baseline throughput of 1 Gbps, and the configuration includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Dedicated graphics hardware is omitted, with a GPU count of zero.

Because the processor resources use a shared allocation model, CPU cycles are divided among multiple tenants on the host hardware. This architecture provides cost-effective multi-threaded capacity but presents the potential for performance variability under prolonged high-utilization conditions. The server is suited for development environments, code compilation, staging systems, background batch workers, and non-latency-sensitive web services.
